objective: Direct complete SMPL-H causal motion estimation from its COCO-regressed raw stereo 2D projections, with no independent Cartesian joint states or 3D observation term.
manual_semantics: human-confirmed hand=wrist,foot=ankle; leftt_hand explicit alias;16 points;frame0 only

initialization.historical_cold_start: Current-method frame0 initializer used triangulation; only model parameter fields are read, no 3D point data term.

estimator.state: t3,SO3 root tangent3,VPoser32; each carries velocity/acceleration; covariance114x114
estimator.measurement: calibrated raw left/right fisheye pixels,finite/score/bounds and 2D epipolar gate
estimator.history: recursive past state;current pixels;no future or batch short window
estimator.update: single error-state EKF with robust per-point R, soft VPoser regularizer, bounded common gain for q/v/a AND Joseph covariance
estimator.derivatives: full SMPL-H model-point instantaneous derivatives with curvature, eps0.01s; retain raw values and mask poor/stale-fit public derivatives

validation_target: Complete licensed-model mesh and parameter regeneration; exact COCO-regressor interface; causal dt/expiry/masking/scaled covariance contracts. No 3D accuracy claim.
comparison: Standalone baseline; previous free-point and intermediate versions differ in more than one factor, not a controlled single-variable ablation.
success: Implementation/export contracts and 13 targeted tests passed; all448 records retained. Numerical pose availability is separate from 2D fit or derivative quality.
quality_result: Insufficient full-sequence 2D fit: median36.23725/P95135.28643px; no mainline promotion or physical kinematics claim.
stop: Source/image/calibration/time/model contract mismatch or non-finite numerical state stops. Rejected updates keep short prediction;0.1s loss expires; no relaxed gates, interpolation, old fits or future frames. No further blind parameter sweep this phase.
diagnostic_design: Fixed same shape/hands/foot/neck/head and calibration; midpoint224 and worst per-frame median412; current-frame-only 2D Adam200 steps,latent lr0.02/root0.003/transl0.001,sigma8px,Huber25px,zprior1.5; remove temporal prior/correction cap; not inserted into final trajectory. v2/v3 q/v/a arrays verified identical.

preserved_versions.run: 36 available; hard latent3, rejected updates and truncated statuses
preserved_versions.run_v2: 448 but poor pixel fit/model-innovation gate bias
preserved_versions.run_v3: pure2D epipolar gate, still poor fit
preserved_versions.run_manual_v1: manual frame0 refinement; reused initializer, earlier motion implementation
preserved_versions.run_final: failed constrained iterative update; mean clipped but full covariance information caused drift,P95677.54px
preserved_versions.run_final_v2: matched gain/Joseph; current rejection quality handling subsequently tightened
preserved_versions.run_final_v3: current complete baseline; inadequate image fit remains

limits: No independent 3D pose, derivative, exposure-time, contact or world truth.
Frozen single-frame shape and regressor anatomical correspondence may be biased.
Engineering R/Q/covariance and fit masks are not calibrated probabilities or correctness certificates.
Camera-coordinate derivatives include camera motion; world/Stage/heel constraint and short-window extension remain unimplemented.
The user whole walker-motion-stage fixed-world-heel assumption is retained for a separate world comparison; annotated ankles are not heels.
